current.title: Your plan
current.description: What your company is on, and what happens next.
current.free: Free — no card needed. Upgrade any time below.
current.granted: Included by Workus — nothing to pay, no card needed. Every feature of this plan is on.
current.endsOn: Switches to Starter on {{date}} — the subscription ends then.
current.pastDue: The last payment failed. Update your card under Manage billing before {{date}}, or your company goes back to Starter.
current.manageHint: Update the card or download invoices. Plan changes work right here.

plans.title: Plans
plans.description: Monthly, cancel any time. Upgrades are charged at once.
plans.descriptionSubscribed: Upgrades apply at once; downgrades and cancellations at the end of the paid period.
plans.terms: Prices in US dollars. Going back to Starter keeps your data: adding employees and paid features wait until you upgrade again.

features.exports: Export of change history and security log

testMode.title: Test mode:
testMode.card: no real money moves. Pay with card 4242 4242 4242 4242, any future expiry date and any CVC.

notice.upgraded: Your company is now on the {{plan}} plan.

banner.pastDue: Your last payment failed. Update your card before {{date}}, or the company goes back to Starter.

upgrade.title: Upgrade to {{plan}}?
upgrade.text: The difference for the rest of this period is charged to your card, and {{plan}} opens right away.

downgrade.title: Downgrade to {{plan}}?
downgrade.text: Until then you keep {{current}}. Its features lock on that day — nothing is deleted.

giveUp.title: Switch to Starter?
giveUp.text: The paid features lock right away — nothing is deleted. Adding people waits while you are over 10 employees.

keep.title: Keep {{plan}}?
keep.text: The scheduled change is dropped and {{plan}} continues as before.

done.upgrade: Your company is now on the {{plan}} plan.
done.giveUp: Your company is now on Starter.
